topic: Storage/maintenance leaks: maintenance crons never installed, snapshot retention unbounded, embed backfill stalls — silent-maintenance class, PRIORITY
notes:
OPERATOR-FLAGGED PRIORITY (2026-06-13). Discovered via "118GB edges dir" investigation; manual cleanup already performed (bbox_storage_gc max_snapshot_age_days=0: 209 files / 90.7 GB reclaimed, edges 117G→32G; backups and orphans deliberately untouched).

Three gaps, one root class — maintenance that exists but silently never runs:

1. gap-f268badd [high] maintenance crons never installed. bro_cron_list = [] while daily-compaction-arc (storage GC + vector compaction) and the embed-compaction cron packet sit installed-but-unscheduled. Storage GC has NEVER run automatically. Fix: install crons at bootstrap/deploy + doctor/inbox check for "installed maintenance workflow with no cron". Compose with the bbox_inbox attention layer like the gap-1168b0bd connectivity alerts.

2. gap-efd270dd [high] snapshot retention unbounded. Per-commit head-<sha> materialized snapshots (≤1.6 GB each), retention = 14-day age default + small recent floors, no count/byte budget → ~100 GB steady state at multi-agent commit rate EVEN WITH daily GC. The arc's StorageGc node also omits max_snapshot_age_days. Fix: count/byte-budget retention + tighten arc args + consider delta/ref-count materialization (consecutive snapshots are near-identical).

3. gap-b9d39c10 [medium] embed backfill stalls invisible. git_message 0% / notes 68% / code 93% coverage with EMPTY queues and health=ok; transcripts route reports null. Vector search silently incomplete per route. Fix: diagnose residue-never-enqueued, health flags low-coverage+idle-queue, transcripts reports guarded state explicitly.

Sequencing suggestion: 1 first (smallest, unblocks recurring GC + nightly embed compaction including the new connectivity gate), then 2's policy change rides the now-scheduled arc, then 3's diagnosis. Related context: thread-098387b3 (search-arc residuals; connectivity guard + journal fix were the same silent-maintenance class).

Gap 1 (gap-f268badd) ADDRESSED — worktree storage-maintenance-leaks, commits 9d0119b4 + 1750ec14. (a) Prod remediated live: daily-compaction cron (03:15 UTC) + embed-compaction-nightly (03:30 UTC) installed with their missing workflow/packets via bbox_artifact_install; bro_cron_list confirms both scheduled — storage GC runs automatically for the first time tonight. (b) bbox_inbox gains "Cron scheduling gaps": cron-routing packets with no live cron (maintenance exists but never runs) + live crons with missing routing packet (ticks dispatch nowhere); tested both directions. (c) system-defaults/maintenance/scripts/install-maintenance.sh = idempotent one-command deploy step, wired into docs/operations.md post-upgrade checklist. Startup auto-install deliberately not added (ops-artifact-bundles design non-goal). Heads-up: once the new binary deploys, the inbox will correctly flag badgey/cron-routing as unscheduled (badgey crons were never installed either — operator call whether to schedule them). NEXT: gap 2 retention policy now rides the scheduled arc.

ALL THREE GAPS ADDRESSED — worktree storage-maintenance-leaks (branch worktree-storage-maintenance-leaks, 6 commits 9d0119b4..660a26b1, full suite 3,962 green). Gap 2 (gap-efd270dd, 883d6ad9): SnapshotRetentionPolicy gains per-workspace count (32) + byte (16 GiB) budgets bounding the age keep; dir-grain decisions, floors win; in-daemon 6h pass inherits via default; daily-compaction-arc v2 on prod (old binary honors age=7 tonight, budgets at deploy). Remaining (acknowledged in gap note): delta/ref-count snapshot materialization — separate design work, pressure now bounded. Gap 3 (gap-b9d39c10, 08ad4938): root cause = NO backfill path existed (enqueue only at creation); added bbox_reembed route="backfill" + embed-compaction-arc v3 nightly node (on prod), health=stalled for coverage<0.98+idle-queue, transcripts explicit coverage_state. Prod remediated live: git_message 0→1.0, knowledge/agent_manifest→1.0, notes/code draining. DEPLOY NOTE: daemon redeploy from this branch activates the inbox cron-gap check, the snapshot budgets, the stall health, and the backfill route; until then old binary warns on route="backfill" nightly (harmless; manual refills already ran). Post-deploy, inbox will correctly flag badgey/cron-routing as unscheduled — operator call. Worktree branch ready to merge into beta/blackbox-v2.

MERGED + DEPLOYED 2026-06-13. Fast-forwarded beta/blackbox-v2 to 660a26b1, release build, binaries installed (blackboxd/blackboxd-dev/bro), memories synced, both services restarted clean, install-maintenance.sh run end-to-end against the new daemon (validating the new deploy step; artifact provenance re-pinned to base-repo paths). LIVE VERIFICATION: crons survived restart (daily-compaction 03:15, embed-compaction-nightly 03:30); inbox "Cron scheduling gaps" live, correctly flagging exactly badgey/cron-routing; transcripts coverage_state explicit; health=stalled fired immediately on the session's own merge residue (git_message 0.885, knowledge 0.965) and one bbox_reembed(route="backfill") on the new binary converged git_message/knowledge/notes/threads/agent_manifest to 1.0. NEW FINDING the visibility surfaced: code route's last 0.7% (595 items) is provider-rejected payloads — Voyage HTTP 400 drops the whole 52-item batch after 3 retries, flips route unavailable, re-churns every nightly backfill. Filed gap-e3e033ce (poison-payload per-item bisect + skip-list + chunk sanitization), committed a162da94 on beta. Remaining thread residue: badgey cron scheduling decision (operator), delta/ref-count snapshot materialization (gap-efd270dd note), gap-e3e033ce.

gap-e3e033ce (voyage poison batches) ADDRESSED + DEPLOYED 2026-06-13. Root cause confirmed by live Voyage probe: empty-string chunks → HTTP 400, dropping the whole 52-item batch after 3 retries. Fix (commit 857206b0): empty/whitespace text skipped at enqueue + excluded from coverage (shared embeddable_text predicate); payload-level 4xx classified non-retryable so the queue bisects to the poison item instead of retry-then-drop; durable dropped_count/last_dropped on RouteStatus that mark_success can't clear; poison isolation keeps the route available; stall reason distinguishes poison from un-enqueued residue. Full suite 3,966 green. Merged to beta/blackbox-v2 (ff), release build, binaries installed, both services restarted. LIVE VERIFICATION: code route converged 0.9933 → 1.0 (88185/88185), dropped_count=0 across ALL routes (no genuine poison beyond empty strings), coverage_state guard renders on transcripts. The whole storage-maintenance-leaks thread is now closed: gap-f268badd (crons), gap-efd270dd (snapshot budgets), gap-b9d39c10 (backfill/stall visibility), gap-e3e033ce (poison payloads) all addressed + deployed. Open follow-ups (not blocking): badgey cron scheduling decision (operator), delta/ref-count snapshot materialization (design), cross-restart poison skip-list + chunk-time sanitization (gap-e3e033ce wishlist, low priority now that empty-text is skipped pre-enqueue). Recommend resolving this thread.
